scope: Paragraph-to-utterance segmentation trained on TalkBank; words only; no speaker-turn boundaries or rule features; no audio ASR claim
architecture: Two transformer encoder layers, width 64, four heads; word and position embeddings; binary word-gap boundary prediction
design: Child-disjoint 70/15/15 per corpus; exact duplicate sessions grouped; validation-only epoch and threshold selection

additional_evaluation.scope: Frozen model; additional labels never used for training or model selection
